2950881.title: There Are Machines Inside Animals
2950881.overview: A hands-on children's exhibition at the National Institute of Ecology's Ecorium, revealing the mechanical principles hidden in how animals move. Kids guess how each creature works, then test their theory through interactive displays.
2950881.place: Ecorium Special Exhibition Hall, National Institute of Ecology
2950881.fee: Adults 5,000 won · Youth 3,000 won · Children 2,000 won

3369503.title: Sound Park Festival
3369503.overview: A free outdoor music festival running since 2016, pairing top Korean acts with the region's best local musicians in full-band live sets. Held on the outdoor stage of the Kimdaejung Convention Center alongside the Gwangju beer fest.
3369503.sponsor: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism · Gwangju

3382746.title: Art Gwangju 24 International Art Fair
3382746.overview: The Honam region's largest art fair, with 113 Korean and international gallery booths plus special exhibitions, artist talks, hands-on programs, and docent tours for first-time collectors.

140682.title: Seocheon Maryangjin Port Sunset & Sunrise Festival
140682.overview: Maryangjin is one of the rare west-coast spots where you can watch both the year's last sunset and the New Year's first sunrise over water, and this year-end gathering marks both with wish-making events at the port.

3051471.title: Goods Is Good V.2
3051471.overview: A four-day showcase where creators and companies in video, illustration, and story content sell character goods and share the stories behind them — run by the organizers of the Seoul Illustration Fair.

2940823.title: 3rd Gangneung International Art Festival (GIAF25)
2940823.overview: A month-long art festival threading contemporary works through Gangneung's old spaces — the station, warehouses, the old government office, even a former clinic — around stories passed down through the UNESCO-listed Gangneung Danoje rites.

3443073.title: Future Ground
3443073.overview: An XR-sports playground where your body is the controller: dodge lasers in X-RUNNER, play virtual football in XR KICKER, and watch your drawings come alive — 16 interactive attractions in one venue.
3443073.place: Lotte Mall Gimpo Airport, 1F exhibition hall

3526695.title: 6th Blue Sky Day Celebration
3526695.overview: A clean-air awareness festival at Seoul Plaza for the UN's International Day of Clean Air, with quiz shows, kids' speech contests, live music, and eco-friendly hands-on booths run by the environment ministry.

1621746.title: Hwadojin Festival
1621746.overview: Incheon's oldest military-camp festival, now in its 36th year, reenacting the history of Hwadojin — the Joseon fort built against 19th-century foreign incursions. Costumed processions and appointment ceremonies anchor three days of performances, traditional military experiences, and night markets around Dongincheon Station and Hwadojin Park.
1621746.place: Dongincheon Station north plaza and Hwadojin Park

3378217.title: Chuncheon Forest Recreation Camp Festa & Dog-Cat Games
3378217.overview: A campground culture festa in the cypress forests of Chuncheon, 40 minutes from Seoul: live acts, slime and wood-fired pizza workshops, perfume-making, and pet-friendly events alongside glamping under the stars.

2487791.title: Seoul Africa Festival
2487791.overview: Korea's largest festival dedicated to African culture, running since 2016 with embassies and communities: music and dance stages, an Asia-Africa talent award, a fashion show of African brands, food booths, and hands-on programs at DDP.
2487791.sponsor: Africa Insight · African Diplomatic Corps in Korea · Seoul Design Foundation

3532971.title: Busan Seo-gu Medical Tourism Festival
3532971.overview: A health-and-tourism festival at Songdo Ocean Park run with Busan's four university hospitals: free health screenings, CPR classes, wellness yoga, kids' doctor experiences, and a global food zone — showcasing the city's official medical tourism district.

1690237.title: Sanjicheon Festival
1690237.overview: A stream-side festival in downtown Jeju City along the Sanjicheon, the old lifeline of the walled town. It opens with the UNESCO-listed Chilmeoridang Yeongdeunggut shamanic rite, then runs traditional pole fishing, straw-boat making, a song contest, and family programs along the waterway.

3529811.title: Sejong Hangeul Sulsul Festival
3529811.overview: A downtown festival pairing Sejong's brewing industry with Hangeul culture — fitting for the city named after the king who created the alphabet. Local breweries pour tastings alongside food booths, concerts, busking, and pop-up stores around the traditional market.
3529811.place: Sejong Traditional Market and Jochiwon Station plaza

3000221.title: Eunpyeong Youth Festival
3000221.overview: A mystery-themed youth festival at Gupabal: solve the case of the mascot's stolen beanie through storytelling missions, with pop-up booths, western-styled duel shows, circus and music stages, and food trucks.

3522928.title: Songdo Tribowl Jazz Festival
3522928.overview: Jazz fills the waterfront around Songdo's sculptural Tribowl building, indoors and out, with the lit-up architecture as backdrop. Now in its 11th year and a fixture for Incheon's jazz crowd. Free.

1693879.title: Paju Folk Festival
1693879.overview: An evening folk-music festival at the Imjingak Peace Nuri open-air stage near the DMZ, asking 'What is folk?' — revisiting the genre that shaped Korean protest and campus music, with stages spilling into the plaza. Free.

3018095.title: Seongnam Festival
3018095.overview: A tech-arts festival branded 'T.A.G. Seongnam' — Technology, Arts, Game — from the city behind Pangyo's game industry: large-scale projection mapping on natural landscapes, AI sound, AR, and drones across Bundang Central Park and the Tancheon stream.
3018095.place: Bundang Central Park and citywide venues

3533382.title: Entertech Seoul 2025
3533382.overview: A global entertainment-technology festival at DDP hosted by the Seoul city government: K-pop meets XR, virtual idols, and games, with Korean entertainment companies and startups staging tech-driven shows over three days. Free.
3533382.place: DDP Art Hall and Eoullim Plaza

3535742.title: Michuhol Media Culture Festival
3535742.overview: Incheon's community media festival, running since 2004: VR and AR trials, one-person broadcasting workshops, photo and video editing, plus local performances, an art flea market, and kids' zones around the media center.
3535742.place: Incheon National University Jemulpo Campus plaza

577899.title: Soesokkak Festival
577899.overview: A two-day festival at Soesokkak, the jade-green lava-cliff estuary on Jeju's south coast, in its 21st year. Free traditional raft, kayak, and jet-boat rides anchor the program, with a youth rock festival, local performances, and fireworks over Hahyo Port.

3337617.title: Hwaseong Urban-Rural Harmony Festival
3337617.overview: A city-meets-countryside festival by Hwaseong's agricultural technology center: kimchi-making and Chuseok songpyeon workshops, farm experience booths run by local grower groups, kids' art contests, and a trusted local-produce market.

3540355.title: 14th Gangnam Beautiful Architecture Exhibition
3540355.overview: Gangnam's annual architecture showcase, presenting 15 award winners among 289 buildings that shape the district's skyline — with a symposium, silk-screen workshops, winner building tours, and open-office visits to the architects behind them.

622946.title: Guri Cosmos Festival
622946.overview: The capital region's signature autumn flower festival since 2001, drawing over 300,000 visitors to vast cosmos fields along the Han River in Guri, with concerts, food streets, and family programs among the blooms. Free.

2844254.title: Geumcheon Science Festival (G-Science Festival)
2844254.overview: A district science festival for some 9,000 students and residents: motion simulators, an escape-room bus, robot dogs and humanoid robots, AI piano and AI-vs-human showdowns, 3D pens, science magic and bubble shows, and a coding hackathon across five zones around the district office.

2621558.title: Jungnang Yongma Waterfall Festival
2621558.overview: An autumn-night neighborhood arts festival beneath Yongma Falls — one of Asia's tallest artificial waterfalls — with an open-air film night, a residents' talent concours, family bounce zones, and evening stages.
2621558.sponsor: Jungnang Foundation for Arts and Culture

3546110.title: Seoul Hanok Week 2025
3546110.overview: Ten days of hanok culture across Bukchon, Seochon, and the Songhyeon green — exhibitions, lectures, tours, and performances in Seoul's public hanok, themed this year around the garden: the outdoor spaces that complete traditional Korean houses. Some 90 organizations and 50 venues take part.
3546110.place: Bukchon Culture Center and hanok venues

3351622.title: DDP Autumn Festival: Design Lounge
3351622.overview: For three days, giant drawing walls rise around DDP's silver curves and everyone becomes the artist — a participatory coloring festival where thousands of small brush strokes accumulate into one autumn artwork. Free.

3536325.title: EX-Pumpkin Night: Magic Kingdom
3536325.overview: Gyeongju Expo Park's Halloween tradition, in its fifth year: the Hwarang forest becomes a pumpkin kingdom complete with Halloween-styled fire stations, police, and broadcast studios where kids role-play jobs among the night lights.

3532272.title: Gyeonggi Content Festival 2025
3532272.overview: A culture-tech festival at Suwon Convention Center: immersive storytelling exhibitions, XR and AI experiences, webtoon and game showcases, and the K-Culture Trend 2026 forum — open to the public for the first time after a B2B-only debut. Free.

3538633.title: Gwacheon Youth Festival (Eopstival)
3538633.overview: A one-day youth festival built on a joke with teeth: 'everything Gwacheon does not have' — pop-up cinema, board-game cafe, arcade, and pocha street appear in Central Park for a single day, with performances, policy booths, and food trucks.

2560741.title: Geumhogang River Wind Song Festival
2560741.overview: Daegu Buk-gu's riverside festival on the Geumho: six themed zones covering music, healing, food, and water sports, with a river song contest, mass dance performances, themed playgrounds, and an 80-years-of-liberation photo exhibition — run as a low-waste festival.

3368863.title: Yeonnam-dong Community Festival
3368863.overview: A neighborhood festival in Yeonnam — the cafe quarter beside Hongdae — with music and dance stages, family hands-on booths, and markets run by local artists and shopkeepers along the back streets.

3371765.title: Yongin Youth Festival
3371765.overview: A space-themed Youth Day festival planned by young residents themselves, joined by city mascot Joayong: UFO wish-making, perfume and patch workshops, quiz olympics, and youth policy zones at Yongin Mir Stadium.

3011941.title: Hwabuk Port Culture Festival
3011941.overview: A resident-led festival at Hwabuk Port, the old gateway harbor of Jeju, using the neighborhood's maritime history as its stage — performances and hands-on programs by the water.

3018924.title: Dogok Metasequoia Road Festa
3018924.overview: Season two of a street festa under the metasequoia canopy along Yangjaecheon: a 30-team flea market with social-economy makers, food street, one-day classes, an outdoor library, and evening concerts by Korean pop vocalists.

3348362.title: Seongbuk Street Culture Festival (Dada Festa)
3348362.overview: A 200-meter street festival by Seokgwan Elementary bringing together the district's universities, young artists, residents, and immigrant communities — global food and performances, an art market of local creators, and shop-collab flea markets.

2838316.title: National Intangible Heritage Center Outing
2838316.overview: A theatrical tour of the National Intangible Heritage Center in Jeonju: five costumed master characters guide visitors through exhibitions, quizzes, and digital experiences, ending with a performance or a craft workshop.

3354973.title: Gangbuk Youth Festival (Gangchu)
3354973.overview: A retro-themed youth festival at Sungshin Women's University's Mia campus: a retro game playground, teen-planned stages with an original theme song, dance competitions, a mascot contest, and guest sets by Korean pop vocalists.
3354973.place: Sungshin Women's University Unjeong Green Campus

3345603.title: Special Weekends at Yangju Gwanaji
3345603.overview: Weekend heritage programs at the old Yangju government office site: traditional games, hanbok and craft workshops, guided history tours including independence-movement stories, and traditional performance stages for families.

3489468.title: Changdeokgung Palace Herbal Tea House
3489468.overview: The old royal pharmacy inside Changdeokgung — where court physicians once kept the palace's medicinal herbs — reopens as a tea house, serving herbal infusions reinterpreted from the Annals of the Joseon Dynasty in the original building.

2601242.title: Dobong Hangeul Festival
2601242.overview: A Hangeul Day festival in the district where key figures of the alphabet's history rest — King Sejong's daughter Princess Jeongui, collector Jeon Hyeong-pil who saved the Hunminjeongeum manuscript, and poet Kim Su-yeong. The 14th edition marks 579 years since Hangeul's promulgation with exhibitions and family programs at Wondangsaem Park.

2667583.title: Baekdudaegan Bongja Festival
2667583.overview: A native-flower festival at the National Baekdudaegan Arboretum in Bonghwa, built from blooms grown by local farms with local artists and merchants. This edition, 'Flowers, longing for stars', carries a message about living together through climate change.

506838.title: Jeonju International Hanji Industry Fair
506838.overview: A fair celebrating Jeonju hanji — the city's thousand-year tradition of mulberry paper — running since 1997, with a national hanji craft competition and exhibitions reinterpreting the paper's industrial and cultural uses.

780198.title: Hadong Bukcheon Cosmos & Buckwheat Flower Festival
780198.overview: Cosmos and white buckwheat blossoms blanket the farm valley of Bukcheon in Hadong each autumn — a rural landscape festival grown from a farming cooperative, with flower fields, country food, and harvest-season markets. Entry 2,000 won.

3545976.title: Taebaek Festival
3545976.overview: The 44th citizens' festival of Taebaek, the old coal-mining boomtown in the Gangwon highlands, themed on the flavors and spirit of its 1980s heyday — concerts, hands-on programs, and neighborhood stages around Hwangji Pond, the source of the Nakdong River.
3545976.place: Taebaek Culture Plaza and Hwangji Pond

3012095.title: Seoul Light Hangang Bitseom Festival
3012095.overview: Korea's largest light, laser, and media-art festival, rotating across the Han River's islands. The 2025 edition, 'Spectra of Light', turned Ttukseom Hangang Park into ten nights of laser-art installations, a citizen 'Light Run', and lectures bridging art and technology. Free.
